title: Real sessions on the owner's Telco and HyperAck tables, and Home's kind of help on the card
request: Owner: do not wait for me, keep going. Plan step 6 (real-use pass on Telco and HyperAck, capped) and syncing R&D's new H2 route.
spec: dclab-code docs/PARITY_PLAN.md step 6; R&D eff69fe0 (H2: POST /api/drafts/{id}/intent); dclab-code web/draft.js, server/dclab_person.js, server/dclab_runs.js
plan: run the owner's Telco table end to end through the chat (upload, Home, build, stages, evaluation, plots, kept-out columns)
run HyperAck the same way without naming any leak
fix what DCLab Code shows wrong; send R&D findings to the session that owns the files
show H2's kind of help on the card, the person's change relayed as theirs; lock the route

decisions.decision: send the HyperAck finding to the session editing Home instead of fixing draft/chat.py and plan.py here
decisions.why: those files were open with uncommitted work in another session; two writers on one file lose work
the intent route is committed and on GitHub; the other session's uncommitted files touch no route the lock reads

decisions.decision: the person in the live runs answered 'Use your recommendation' to every question
decisions.why: it shows what DCLab decides on its own, which is what the finding is about

change: dclab-code d997bac (card waiting line, job titles at a word), 4d4cebf (type of help on the card, lock).

findings.defect: the Home card was blank until DCLab's first words
findings.scenario: a new draft in the chat: an empty card with only its input box for several seconds
findings.cause: no waiting state before the first stream event
findings.fix: the card says DCLab's agent is reading the problem until its first words or thinking arrive

findings.defect: the intern job's title was cut mid-word
findings.fix: clipWords: cut at a word with an ellipsis; three lines shown, the whole on hover

findings.defect: R&D's Home dropped an honest strong column without asking
findings.scenario: HyperAck: deliverey_category_id forbidden on 'single column separates the classes (AUC 0.816)'; DCLab's reviewer said 'available' (chosen when the order is placed), shown not applied; Home asked only about the fares; holdout 0.664 against the research's honest 0.945
findings.cause: statistics-only flags are kept out unless a person confirms, but Home never asks the person to confirm them
findings.fix: sent to the session owning draft/chat.py and plan.py: ask about every statistics-only or reviewer-disputed forbidden column before a build, with its evidence
findings.test: not yet: the other session's change

findings.defect: R&D's H2 route was not relayed by DCLab Code
findings.fix: a type-of-help bar on the card, Change relayed as the person's click, build button only for a prediction; lock updated
findings.test: page test: the intent drawn from the stream, changed, posted as {track}; units: the act's body check

measurements.name: Telco live
measurements.gate: problem to holdout through the chat, holdout read once, honest answers
measurements.result: ROC-AUC 0.842 (0.821 to 0.865), CV 0.845, customerID kept out, review budgets explained, charts drawn; $0.27

measurements.name: HyperAck live
measurements.gate: the final fares kept out or asked, holdout read once
measurements.result: fares kept out (lift +0.31 caught), holdout read once, but deliverey_category_id dropped without asking: 0.664 vs research 0.945; $0.28 (the chat and the guards held; the gate failed on the column Home dropped)

outcome: DCLab Code carries the owner's real tables from a sentence to an honest holdout number; Home's kind of help is on the card; one R&D Home gap found and handed to its owner.
lessons: A scripted 'use your recommendation' person shows what the system decides alone: that is where a silent default hides.
When the reviewer disagrees with the audit, the disagreement is a question for the person, not a footnote.
risks: F3 stays open until Home asks about statistics-only forbidden columns.
The lock's onGitHub is false while R&D has the other session's uncommitted files.
